evaluation.method: stochastic replay with common random numbers per patient

baseline_fifo.label: Baseline: first come first served, home providers

priority_greedy.label: Priority-aware greedy (urgent first, earliest deadline), home providers

diagnostics_first.label: Conventional: endoscopy units minimise their own appointment dates (transfers allowed), lab FIFO

A_local_pathway.label: End-to-end pathway, home providers only
notes: tier equity: feasible, not proven optimal within time

B_national_pathway.label: End-to-end pathway + eligible patient transfers + sample routing (existing resources)

C_resource_movement.label: B + relocation of an existing surgeon day (origin loses capacity)

recommendation.label: End-to-end pathway + eligible patient transfers + sample routing (existing resources)
recommendation.why: Best existing-resource plan by the lexicographic objective; resource movement is preferred only if it reduces weighted lateness >= 20 % more than patient/sample movement (hypothesis).

A_local_pathway: tier equity: feasible, not proven optimal within time
C_resource_movement: its optimiser prediction did not survive stochastic replay (simulation validation)

recommendation.human_approval: Every action is a recommendation: transfers and relocations need authorisation, patients may decline.
